shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git branch --show-current && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"; rg 'interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject|class Ajv' node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg 'specs/' .lore/test-commands.yml src -g '*.test.ts' | head -30; sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml; git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat tsconfig.json; npm ls ajv @types/ajv --all 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/ajv/lib/ajv.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages[''].dependencies.ajv,p.packages['node_modules/ajv'].version,p.packages['node_modules/ajv'].resolved)\"; git show HEAD"'^:package-lock.json >/dev/null; rg '"'\"node_modules/ajv\"|\"ajv\":' package-lock.json | head -10; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/ajv/package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(tools): preserve validation error paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
